ai_summary: A B Cotspin India Limited has notified the exchanges and its shareholders about the upcoming virtual 29th Annual General Meeting on September 29, 2026, and the online availability of the FY2025-26 Annual Report, fulfilling SEBI disclosure requirements. A key takeaway is the company's strong emphasis on shareholders updating their KYC details and dematerializing physical securities as mandated by a May 2024 SEBI circular. A material impact and potential red flag for investors is the explicit warning that shareholders with incomplete KYC will be ineligible for electronic payments (dividends, interest, redemption) from April 1, 2024, requiring immediate action to avoid forfeiture.
